note: This data is expressed in constant 2021 US$. It is not seasonally adjusted, so it reflects real monthly spending patterns, including slower winter construction and busier summer periods. Inflation adjustment is based on a composite of the Producer Price Indexes (PPIs) for new industrial and new warehouse construction.
title: Monthly spending on data center construction in the United States
subtitle: Cost of on-site work to build data centers each month, including materials and construction labor. It excludes the cost of IT hardware like servers and storage, which can account for a large share of total investment. This data is expressed in US dollars, adjusted for inflation. Only private construction is included.
